name: gildas-ability-usable-again-after-waking-up
notes: Gildas, Faesworn Monarch (g99PIuhU0O): "Stealth, Vigor" + "[Mordred Bonus] (2), [REST]: Prevent the next 4 damage ...". Control for the rested-reactivation fix (gildas-rested-ability-cannot-be-reactivated): the new awake requirement must not lock the ability out for good. Gildas is used in the main phase (2 reserve cards paid, rested), player 1 ends the turn and Vigor wakes Gildas up (Status 2); player 2 attacks the champion with a 6-power Dungeon Guide and in the attack's priority window the AWAKE Gildas is offered and activated a second time via 'myField-1@Activate-0@Prevent' (a second (2) is paid -- 4 reserve cards in total), the champion is the target and takes only 2 of the 6 damage, and Gildas is rested again.

rulesClauses: [REST] cost: a unit can only pay [REST] if it is awake (an already rested Gildas must not be activatable again).
